description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification no. 03/2024, Annual Excise Licence Fees
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the amendment of excise license fees through a statutory instrument (Excise Notification No. 03/2024) issued under the authority of the Excise Ordinance. While it names Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, the core content is regulatory in nature - establishing new fees, rescinding previous regulations, and providing a detailed schedule of licensing requirements. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments rather than focusing on government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
